why: The headline, standfirst, text and both covers still say India were 'around 200' after about 44 overs and that Pakistan's chase had not started. That was the position at about 2 pm IST. India's innings has closed since then, so the top of the site shows an out-of-date, approximate figure (rule 9b). The cover's '22/3, India's early position' stat, shown with a trophy icon, is also weak. frontpages.txt lists the match result as missing.
